whatChangedAndWhy: Four daily-draft runs in a row finished green and opened no PR, so four of last week's seven beats were never drafted — and the one post you approved early, the 10-03 Mood pair, was retired to social/failed/ without a single posting attempt because the 48h staleness clock runs from your approval, not from the post's own slot. I changed three things in the strategy myself (PR #5168, reported not asked, lands on green): the calendar drops to ONE paired beat a day at 23:00Z because the poster's own code caps it there and the doc had been promising double; a beat is now drafted by its own day's run and never parked more than 24h ahead, which is what killed Mood; and the three things you named about the 10-01 Blank Spaces post — a real picture, specific text, a deep link into actual site content — are now three hard criteria instead of an average, with the image score getting its own floor. I also retired lesson L001 (no re-used photos) as codified: it fired six times, it is now check-drafts.mjs's checkPhotoReuse, and nothing has been rejected for a repeat photo since that gate landed on 10-01.
